permissions.name: Manage logbooks and log sheets
permissions.description: Create and archive logbooks, build and publish log sheet templates, and decide who reaches restricted logbooks. Reaches every logbook.

permissions.name: Manage Logbook's people
permissions.description: Invite people or add accounts for Logbook, and give or take back Logbook's delegable roles (Contributor, Reviewer, Viewer) from Logbook itself, without workspace access administration.

permissions.name: Write log entries
permissions.description: Write, save and submit entries on the log sheets one contributes to, and correct entries returned to them.

permissions.name: Review log entries
permissions.description: Mark submitted entries reviewed or return them for correction, on the sheets one reviews. Never one's own entry.

permissions.name: Read log entries
permissions.description: Read every submitted entry, with its history, in the logbooks one reaches.

permissions.name: View reports and export
permissions.description: Counts, summaries and CSV or PDF exports of the entries one can read.

roles.name: Contributor
roles.description: Writes and submits entries, and corrects returned ones.

roles.name: Reviewer
roles.description: Reviews or returns entries written by others, and reads their history.

roles.name: Viewer
roles.description: Reads entries and reports; changes nothing.

roles.name: Auditor
roles.description: Reads entries, reports and the audit trail; changes nothing.

roles.name: Manager
roles.description: Creates logbooks and log sheets, publishes templates, adds people and gives them Logbook roles, decides access, and reads every logbook and its reports.

roles.name: Logbook administrator
roles.description: Everything in Logbook, including the audit trail.

separation_of_duties.description: Logbook refuses review of one's own entry; one person holding both still needs a second reviewer for their own entries.
